title: Change Window Orbit — Standup Journal and Hotfix Planner
content:
Date: 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-11
Timebox: daily 09:30 standup during March change window
Location: Zoom + #release-orbit (Slack)
Owner (doc): Asha Mukherjee
Purpose: capture morning standup notes for the March 9-11 change window, log hotfix candidates, decisions, and action owners; maintain a short running changelog for on-call and SRE handoff.

Attendees:
- Asha M. (release lead)
- Carlos R. (infra engineer)
- Lena P. (serving runtime)
- Tom C. (release conductor)
- Priya P. (SRE)
- Eoin G. (QA automation)
- rotating on-call: SRE shift B

Quick summary (top-of-mind):
- Canary rollout of 1.9.2-serving-runtime continued across us-west-2; token-level latencies within SLO but two error spikes observed at 03/10 02:14 UTC (investigating).
- Small config drift discovered in dedupe-cache policy on dedicated pools — rolled back a recent config change for burst-size, now under observation.
- One hotfix candidate (RELEASE-4321) identified for mis-routed fallback policy causing higher-cost model selection.

Key decisions made:
1) Pause new canary increments until after the 12:00 PST stabilization check (tomorrow) — decision: reduce blast radius, maintain current canary weight at 12%. (Decision by Asha/Tom)
2) Hotfix flow for RELEASE-4321 will be fast-tracked: cherry-pick -> smoke -> canary -> promote. Owner: Carlos R.
3) For the KV-cache error spike, temporary circuit-breaker enabled on affected pool to avoid cascading degrades. Owner: Priya P., will keep circuit-breaker for 4h then evaluate.

Observed signals / telemetry (notes):
- Latency P95 (global): 135ms during steady window; P99 spiked to 820ms at 2026-03-10T02:14:08Z. Traces show long tail on model selection rpc to routing service.
- Error budget burn: hosted-api route /v1/generate consumed 2.7% of daily allowance during spike (alert threshold 3.0%).
- Cost telemetry: dedupe-cache misconfig led to extra model swaps — estimated +7% token cost for affected customers between 03/09-03/10.

Hotfix candidates (triage table):
- RELEASE-4321: fallback routing picks next-cheaper variant incorrectly when under burst. Symptoms: 502s for rare prefixes, observed in Canary logs. Priority: P1 -> fast-track. Owner: Carlos R. -> PR: platform#1184 -> target deploy: 2026-03-10 18:00 UTC (smoke: 18:05).
- RELEASE-4387: small mem leak in quantization cache (low churn pools). Priority: P2 -> schedule for next patch train if no regressions. Owner: Lena P.
- RELEASE-4399: minor telemetry mislabeling in rollout dashboard (affects ops visibility). Priority: P3 -> remediation ticket created. Owner: Eoin G.

Action items (with owners & ETA):
- Carlos R.: prepare hotfix branch, write smoke test to assert fallback behavior, open PR by EOD 2026-03-09. ETA: 2026-03-09 23:59 PST.
- Lena P.: investigate quant cache leak, attach heap profiles from affected hosts, surface possible backport. ETA initial triage: 2026-03-10 12:00 PST.
- Priya P.: maintain circuit-breaker, add runbook note for watchdog, coordinate on-call handover at 2026-03-11 08:00 PST.
- Tom C.: update change-window calendar and notify customers in the beta cohort about extended canary wait. ETA: 2026-03-09 16:00 PST.
- Eoin G.: expand canary traffic shadow to include extra metrics for model-selection RTT. ETA: 2026-03-10 09:00 PST.

Blockers and risks:
- Risk: If canary increment resumes without the hotfix, we risk broader fallback misrouting causing cost and latencies to increase. Mitigation: hold increments and fast-track hotfix.
- Blocker: a flaky integration test prevents automated gating for PR platform#1184. Workaround: add a temporary direct smoke test run in the release lane until the test is stabilized. Owner: Carlos/Tom.

Preflight checklist for hotfix promotion (short):
1) PR passes unit tests and targeted smoke tests (Carlos)
2) Canary at 12% for 30m with no severity >minor (SLO: error budget <0.5%) (Priya/Tom)
3) Manual sanity: top-5 customers in Canary cohort verified (customer success notify) (Tom)
4) Rollback plan documented in PR and on-call runbook (Asha)

Communication plan:
- Post a status note in #release-orbit every 2 hours while fast-track in progress.
- If canary fails, trigger immediate rollback and escalate to exec-ops channel.
- Customer success to reach out to Beta cohort list if promotion delayed more than 12h. Contact: Tom C.

Notes / meeting scribbles (raw):
- 09:36: Asha: observed two correlated spikes; suspected routing policy.
- 09:40: Carlos: isolating PR that introduced fallback prioritization change last week (PR-1142).
- 09:55: Priya: enabled circuit-breaker on pool-gamma; watch CPU & OOM.
- 10:12: Eoin: added extra logging flags for model_selector -> will increase log volume ~8%. OK for 6h.

Follow-ups for next standup (2026-03-10 09:30):
- Carlos to report PR status and smoke results.
- Lena to share heap-profile summary if leak reproduces.
- Priya to give state of circuit-breaker and SLOs.
- Tom to confirm customer notifications sent.

Post-change notes (to be updated after promotion or rollback):
- Promotion result: (placeholder)
- Rollback window (if exercised): (placeholder)
- Postmortem owner assigned if severity > P1 outage.

Retrospective anchor points (if hotfix promoted):
- root cause classification (config drift / code bug / infra flake)
- time-to-detect / time-to-mitigate metrics
- suggested automation to prevent recurrence (canary checks, gating tests)

Misc (links & refs):
- Slack thread: #release-orbit (pinned message)
- Jira: RELEASE-4321, RELEASE-4387, RELEASE-4399
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1184
- Confluence: Change Window Calendar + Standup notes page (add link to final postmortem)

Status snapshot (2026-03-11 08:00 PST):
- Canary held at 12%
- Hotfix PR opened and assigned for review (Carlos)
- Circuit-breaker active, observing reduced error propagation
- Next check-in: 2026-03-10 09:30 daily standup

End of journal entry.

Document notes: this is intended as a living standup log for the March change window — keep it concise. If any action is completed, please strikethrough the line in the copy on Drive and add a timestamped note (format: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM Z] name: done -> short note).
